shortage.title: Shortage Report
shortage.description: Scans every order in the selected statuses and reads its admin note ("یادداشت مدیر") for a shortage signal: a note with no item reference counts the whole order as short, otherwise the referenced item row(s) are resolved from the note.
shortage.liveApiRequired: This report requires the Live API data source (see Settings) -- imported order data has no admin note field or Shopfa status codes.
shortage.loading: Scanning orders and admin notes… this can take a moment.
shortage.wholeOrderShortage: {{count}} order with no item reference (counted whole)
shortage.wholeOrderShortage_other: {{count}} orders with no item reference (counted whole)
shortage.unresolvedNotes: {{count}} note could not be resolved to an item (click to view)
shortage.unresolvedNotes_other: {{count}} notes could not be resolved to an item (click to view)
shortage.noShortages: No shortages found for the selected statuses.
shortage.unresolvedDialogTitle: Notes that could not be resolved to an item
shortage.unresolvedDialogDescription: These orders' admin notes mention "مورد"/"موارد" but couldn't be matched to a specific item row (e.g. an "all except N" phrasing) -- review them manually.
